szoveg_eredeti:
This week on Tales Over Cocktails: AI chaos, Hinge horrors, Taylor Swift’s “Patient Zero,” the Cornell (5)7, and a Wendy & Astra kerfuffle that went WAY too far.

We spill the tea on how a little AI-generated fun turned into a full-blown text war between us. We also touch upon Danielle's dating life, dissect Taylor's newest music video and how relatable it is. On a more somber note, we cover the tragic story out of Cornell University.
